chunks.arabic_text: اَلْكَافِيّ: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَيْصِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Iys ibn al-Qasim who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:

chunks.arabic_text: عَلَيْكُمْ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَانْظُرُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكُونُ لَهُ الْغَنَمُ فِيهَا الرَّاعِي، فَإِذَا وَجَدَ رَجُلًا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِغَنَمِهِ مِنَ الَّذِي هُوَ فِيهَا يَخْرُجُهُ وَيَجِيءُ بِذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِغَنَمِهِ مِنَ الَّذِي كَانَ فِيهَا، وَاللَّهُ لَوْ كَانَتْ لِأَحَدِكُمْ نَفَسَانِ، يُقَاتِلُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ يُجَرِّبُهَا ثُمَّ كَانَتِ الْأُخْرَى بَاقِيَةً، فَعَمِلَ عَلَى مَا قَدِ اسْتَبَانَ لَهَا، وَلَكِنْ لَهُ نَفَسٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، إِذَا ذَهَبَتْ فَقَدْ ذَهَبَتِ التَّوْبَةُ، فَأَنْتُمْ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْتَارُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ

translations.en: Upon you is to fear God alone, who has no partner, and to look after yourselves. For by Allah, a man may possess a flock with a shepherd; when he finds another man who is more knowledgeable about his flock than the one currently tending it, he removes the latter and replaces him with the more knowledgeable man. If one of you had two souls, one of which he could fight with and risk, while the other remained safe to act upon the truth that had become clear to him, it would be fine. But he has only one soul; if it is lost, then by Allah, repentance is lost. You are best placed to choose for yourselves.

chunks.arabic_text: إِنْ أَتَاكُمْ آتٍ مِنَّا فَانْظُرُوا عَلَى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ تَخْرُجُونَ، وَلَا تَقُولُوا خَرَجَ زَيْدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، فَإِنَّ زَيْدًا كَانَ عَالِمًا وَكَانَ صَدُوقًا، وَلَمْ يَدْعُكُمْ إِلَى نَفْسِهِ، إِنَّمَا دَعَاكُمْ إِلَى الرِّضَا مِنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ، وَلَوْ ظَهَرَ لَوَفَى بِمَا دَعَاكُمْ إِلَيْهِ، إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ إِلَى سُلْطَانٍ مُجْتَمَعٍ لِيَنْقُضَهُ، فَالْخَارِجُ مِنَّا الْيَوْمَ إِلَى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ يَدْعُوكُمْ؟ إِلَى الرِّضَا مِنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ؟ فَإِنَّا نَشْهَدُكُمْ إِنَّا لَسْنَا نَرْضَى بِهِ، وَهُوَ يَعِصِينَا الْيَوْمَ، وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ أَحَدٌ، وَهُوَ إِذَا كَانَتِ الرِّجَالُ وَالْأَلْوِيَةُ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لَا يَسْمَعَ مِنَّا إِلَّا مَعَ مَنْ اجْتَمَعَتْ بَنُو فَاطِمَةَ مَعَهُ، وَاللَّهُ مَا صَاحِبُكُمْ إِلَّا مَنْ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَيْهِ

translations.en: If a person from us comes to you, scrutinize what you are revolting over. Do not say 'Zayd ibn Ali revolted,' for Zayd was a scholar and truthful, and he did not call you to himself, but rather called you to the Rida (pleasing choice) from the family of Muhammad (peace be upon them). Had he become victorious, he would have fulfilled what he called you to. He only went to the united Sultan to overthrow him. But the one from us today, what is he calling you to? Is it to the Rida from the family of Muhammad? We bear witness that we are not pleased with him, and he disobeys us today while having no following. When the banners and flags converge, he will be more likely to not listen to us except when the children of Fatima are united with him. By Allah, your companion is none other than the one around whom they unite.

chunks.arabic_text: إِذَا كَانَ رَجَبٌ فَأَقْبِلُوا عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَإِنْ أَحْبَبْتُمْ أَنْ تَتَأَخَّرُوا إِلَى شَعْبَانَ فَلَا ضَيْرَ، وَإِنْ أَحْبَبْتُمْ أَنْ تَصُومُوا فِي أَهْلِيكُمْ فَلَعَلَّ ذَلِكَ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَقْوَى لَكُمْ، وَكَفَاكُمْ بِالسُّفْيَانِيِّ عَلَامَةً

translations.en: When Rajab arrives, proceed in the name of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. If you wish to delay until Sha'ban, there is no harm. If you prefer to fast in your families, perhaps that is stronger for you. The Sufyani is sufficient as a sign for you.

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) employs the analogy of a shepherd selecting the most knowledgeable caretaker to urge believers to critically evaluate religious authority, distinguishing Zayd ibn Ali’s call to the general 'Rida' (satisfaction) of the Ahl al-Bayt from later claimants who may act independently. He emphasizes that true leadership is contingent upon the unity of the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly when political power is consolidated, and concludes with eschatological markers including the appearance of the Sufyani. This narration underscores the Shia principle of 'Tawqi' (authorization) and the necessity of verifying a leader's alignment with the Imams' teachings rather than mere lineage or popularity.
en.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq distinguish between Zayd ibn Ali and later claimants to leadership?

key_terms.الرِّضَا: The pleasing choice or designated Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.آل مُحَمَّدٍ: The family of the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.بَنُو فَاطِمَةَ: The children of Fatima (progeny of the Imams)
key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: The Sufyani, a key eschatological figure in Shia tradition
key_terms.رَجَب: The seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar
